# Figma assets

`figma-originals/` contains the image files extracted from the supplied `Караоке-клуб +.fig` archive. The originals keep their archive IDs and native formats; `figma-originals/manifest.json` records their dimensions and sizes.

The following descriptive copies are used by the site:

- `performer.png`, `brick-wall.png`, `microphone.png`, `slippers.png`
- `karaoke-room-*.jpg` and `karaoke-lounge.jpg` for the club and hall photography
- `booking-screen-01.jpg` through `booking-screen-08.jpg` for the booking flow

The descriptive files are byte-for-byte copies of the corresponding source assets.
